$comment: Capability vocabulary v0 (blueprint 727, Epic 3 bead 3.3). Maps every tool token shape in the corpus to an abstract capability from the canonical contract (skill-contract.schema.json). ONE parser owns tokenization: scripts/lib/tool-token-parser.mjs — a gate that parses tool tokens any other way is the anti-pattern this file ends. Coverage is enforced by scripts/check-capability-coverage.mjs: a token that neither maps here nor appears in dispositions fails CI. UPSTREAM-PENDING alongside the skill contract (kernel proposal is E3.13).

capabilities.shell.exec: Execute shell commands (scoped by command list)
capabilities.user.prompt: Ask the operating user a question and wait
capabilities.service.mcp: Call a named MCP server (scoped by server name)
capabilities.service.custom: Call a platform-specific named tool a pack declares (scoped by namespace)
capabilities.agent.control: Monitor, resume, or stop background tasks

mcp.$comment: mcp__<server>[__<tool>] maps to service.mcp scoped by server name; the canonical contract records it as requires.services[{kind: mcp, name: <server>}].

namespaced.$comment: <ns>:<tool> custom platform tool names map to service.custom scoped by namespace, pending Epic 4's per-pack runtime-safety review.

dispositions.$comment: Enumerated corpus tokens that parse as 'unknown' — each carries a reason. Every entry below lives in a .source.json mirror subtree: mirror files are upstream-owned and never edited locally (the never-clobber rule), so their shapes are tolerated here and any repair flows by upstreaming. An unknown token NOT listed here fails the coverage gate.

tolerated.tweet_explore: hermes-tweet mirror: upstream declares bare custom tool names; maps conceptually to service.custom, repair upstream-only
tolerated.tweet_read: hermes-tweet mirror: upstream declares bare custom tool names; maps conceptually to service.custom, repair upstream-only
tolerated.tweet_action: hermes-tweet mirror: upstream declares bare custom tool names; maps conceptually to service.custom, repair upstream-only
tolerated.Read Glob Grep Bash: claude-workflow-skills mirror: upstream uses space-separated tool lists; every member is a mapped builtin, repair upstream-only
tolerated.Read Glob Grep Bash WebSearch WebFetch: claude-workflow-skills mirror: space-separated legacy shape; every member is a mapped builtin, repair upstream-only
tolerated.Read Glob Grep Bash Edit Write: claude-workflow-skills mirror: space-separated legacy shape; every member is a mapped builtin, repair upstream-only
